title: On-Policy Self-Evolution via Failure Trajectories for Agentic Safety Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical framework for agentic safety alignment (FATE), addressing issues like prompt injection and harmful task execution in LLM agents. While it utilizes benchmarks that measure 'harmful compliance' (such as AgentHarm), its primary contribution is an algorithmic training method for alignment rather than an evaluation or study of religion, moral philosophy, or ethical frameworks.
